This compound is identified as a target of multiple entities, including Lactase-phlorizin hydrolase and Beta-D-Glucopyranosyl-(Z)-3-Hexenol, which in turn are targets of the same compound. These findings suggest that the compound may interact with the transporter protein through a series of molecular pathways, possibly involving the modulation of anion transport activity. The evidence is supported by a combination of direct and indirect interactions, with the final score indicating a moderate level of confidence in the relationship. The mechanism is likely mediated through the interaction of the compound with the transporter, though further experimental validation is needed to confirm the exact nature of the interaction.
